name: Should I focus on cosmetic updates or major structural repairs first in a foreclosed home?

mainEntity.name: Should I focus on cosmetic updates or major structural repairs first in a foreclosed home?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is generally advisable to prioritize major structural repairs and essential system upgrades (plumbing, electrical, HVAC) before undertaking cosmetic updates. Addressing foundational issues, roof damage, or outdated wiring ensures the property's safety and long-term integrity. Cosmetic improvements, such as painting and new flooring, are typically the final stages, as they can be easily damaged during more significant construction work. This approach provides a solid base for your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize structural repairs and essential system upgrades before cosmetic updates to ensure property safety and integrity.
